name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: "Whether to run Claude Code"
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: "Whether to create PR in docs-new"
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: "Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)"
        required: true
        default: 50
        type: number

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: ".nvmrc"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_release
        run: |
          # Get the latest release tag from the repository
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          echo "latest_tag=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Setup Claude Code
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true'
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          max_turns: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
          timeout_minutes: 10
          prompt_file: "scripts/docs-automation/prompt.txt"
          settings: |
            {
              "flavor_mapping": {
                "instantsearch.js": "javascript",
                "react-instantsearch": "react",
                "vue-instantsearch": "vue"
              }
            }

      - name: Generate documentation changes
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true'
        run: |
          # This step would typically run the Claude Code execution
          # and generate the documentation changes
          echo "Generating documentation changes..."
          mkdir -p docs-changes
          # In a real implementation, this would process Claude's output
          # and create the necessary MDX files in docs-changes/

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          commit-message: "docs: update documentation for ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          title: "docs: update documentation for ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated to update documentation for the latest release.
            
            - Updates documentation for all packages in this release
            - Generated by Claude Code automation
            
            Fixes #0
          branch: docs-update-${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_tag }}
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            automated pr
          draft: true
          reviewers: |
            frontend-experiences-web

      - name: Dry Run Output
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'false' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Dry run mode: Would process release ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          echo "Would run Claude Code: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude }}"
          echo "Would create PR: ${{ github.event.inputs.create_pr }}"
          echo "Max turns: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns || 50 }}"

      - name: Preview Mode
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Preview mode: Claude Code executed successfully"
          echo "Release processed: ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          echo "Changes would be included in PR"
